SEARCH
Package src

Interface IndexStorageBarrelInterface

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
IndexStorageBarrel
public interface IndexStorageBarrelInterface extends Remote
The IndexStorageBarrelInterface interface represents the remote interface for an index storage barrel. It defines the methods that can be invoked remotely on an index storage barrel object.
